sections.title: Charanam 1
lyrics: anthanintha gollEthala arachethi mANikyamu - panthamAdEy kamsuni pAli vajramu
kAnthula moodu lokAla garudapachapoosa - chenthala mAlonunna chinni krishNudu
Charanams 2 & 3 similar in tune to Charanam 1
Charanam 2 - rathikeli rukmiNiki rangumovi pagadamu - mithi gOvardhanapu gomedikamu
sathamye shankhachakrAla sandula vaidooryamu - gathiyai mammu gAchE kamalAkshudu
Charanam 3 - kAlinguni talapye gappina pushyarAgamu - yEllEti shri vEnkatAdhri indraneelamu
pAlajalanidhilona bAyani divya rathnamu - bAluneevalE dhrigi padhmanAbhudu
